name: discord-activity-sync
description: A simple no-config Discord RPC extension

discord-activity-sync.showFileName.description: Show the active file name in your Discord status

discord-activity-sync.showLineNumbers.description: Show the current line and column numbers

discord-activity-sync.showTotalLines.description: Show the total number of lines in the active file

discord-activity-sync.showGitBranch.description: Show the current Git branch name

discord-activity-sync.showDiagnostics.description: Show the number of errors and warnings in the workspace

discord-activity-sync.idleTimeout.description: Number of minutes of inactivity before showing 'Idle' status. Set to 0 to disable.

discord-activity-sync.timeTracking.description: How to track elapsed time. 'session' for extension active time, 'file' resets when changing files.

discord-activity-sync.buttonEnabled.description: Enable interactive buttons on your Discord profile

discord-activity-sync.buttonLabel.description: The text shown on the button

discord-activity-sync.buttonUrl.description: The URL for the button. Use '{git-origin}' for your git repository's origin.

discord-activity-sync.showDebugging.description: Show 'Debugging...' state when a debug session is active

discord-activity-sync.showLiveShare.description: Show 'Pair Programming' state when a Live Share session is active
